authority: This file defines the canonical static-analysis, compiler-warning, and suppression disposition for every active STRling ecosystem. toolchain.json remains authoritative for executable versions and commands.

inventory_groups.reason: Import-order exceptions support explicit path bootstrapping or re-exports; type-checker directives predate a governed Python type checker and must not expand.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Keep only narrowly coded import/re-export exceptions and retire broad type ignores as a governed Python type checker is introduced.

inventory_groups.reason: The canonical JVM bridge validates decoded JSON objects before two narrow erased-map casts; adapter tests use local unchecked casts only to assert the exact canonical request envelope.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Retain only while the Java adapter projects the versioned JSON protocol through erased Map values; re-audit if a generated typed protocol model replaces those boundaries.

inventory_groups.reason: Kotlin adapter tests use narrow unchecked casts to assert canonical JSON request envelopes; the retained exec compatibility refusal intentionally keeps an unused source parameter.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Retain only while the Kotlin facade projects the versioned JSON protocol through erased Map values and preserves the explicit exec refusal signature.

inventory_groups.reason: ts-jest diagnostic 151002 recommends isolatedModules for the NodeNext transform, but controlled adoption caused all 19 Jest suites to fail before execution while strict tsc remained clean.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Remove the exact-code waiver when the governed Jest/ts-jest ESM transform supports isolatedModules or stops emitting diagnostic 151002 after a separately authorized dependency/toolchain transition.

inventory_groups.reason: Three directives belong to the upstream Gradle wrapper portability implementation.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Retain only while the repository-managed Gradle wrapper remains; re-audit when the wrapper changes.

waivers.reason: The governed Python paths contain pre-existing import-order, re-export, and type-checker directives while no repository type checker is pinned.
waivers.retirement_condition: Retain only coded interop exceptions and retire broad type ignores as Python type analysis becomes enforceable.

waivers.reason: The canonical JVM bridge and Java adapter tests require narrow erased-map casts at validated JSON protocol boundaries.
waivers.retirement_condition: Re-audit if a generated typed Java protocol model replaces the versioned JSON Map projections.

waivers.reason: Kotlin request-envelope tests require narrow erased-map casts, and the explicit exec compatibility refusal preserves an intentionally unused parameter.
waivers.retirement_condition: Re-audit if a generated typed Kotlin protocol model replaces Map projections or the compatibility refusal is retired.

waivers.reason: The governed ts-jest 29.1.2 ESM transform emits diagnostic 151002 under NodeNext; enabling isolatedModules caused every TypeScript test suite to fail before executing, while the authoritative strict tsc check remains clean.
waivers.retirement_condition: Re-evaluate during the separately authorized Node/Jest/ts-jest transition and remove this exact diagnostic-code waiver once isolatedModules is compatible with all 19 suites or the diagnostic is no longer emitted.

waivers.reason: The repository-managed Gradle wrapper carries upstream portability directives.
waivers.retirement_condition: Re-audit when the Gradle wrapper changes.
